Natural Resources Canada, Canadian Industry Program for Energy Conservation (CIPEC), and the Mining Association of Canada (2005). Benchmarking the Energy Consumption of Canadian Open-Pit Mines. Ottawa: CIPEC c/o NRCan Office of Energy Efficiency. ISBN 0-662-39538-7; Cat. No. M144-70/2005E. Prepared by Corporate Renaissance Group for MAC and NRCan (authors not named).

Locators are PRINTED page numbers (PDF page = printed + 6). Survey of 9 Canadian open-pit mines of MAC members, calendar year 2000: 4 gold (incl. heap-leach mines, mill-ore share only), 3 iron ore, 2 oil sands (mining only, no drilling/blasting). All energy in kWhe (Table 2.1 factors, explosives included) per kilotonne; converted to kWh/t by /1000 with the formula column. Loaded: (A) mining stages per t material removed (ore+waste): value = weighted average and min = lowest from the Sect. 4.2 savings table, max = Sect. 3.3.4 high; (B) mining stages per t ore mined: weighted average from Fig. 3.5 data labels (printed numbers) plus Sect. 3.3 high : low; (C) mill/concentrator stages for all 7 plants (Sect. 3.4 ranges + Fig. 3.5 averages); (D, E) iron ore concentration and gold milling separately: weighted average and lowest plant (benchmark) from the Sect. 4.3 tables. Waste-rock stages per t ore mined, G&A, sample statistics, prices and energy-cost figures in other-values; the Sect. 4 benchmark-gap savings in measures (cost column = annual energy-cost saving, not investment). Per-mine bar labels not loaded (anonymous mines, sorted differently in each chart). NOT supplied: carrier split per stage (no diesel vs electric split for haulage or shovels; trolley not mentioned), conveyors, ventilation/heating (open pit), equipment costs, TRL. Traps: Sect. 4.2 'Total kt' column (326, 533) only reproduces the $M as Mt; blasting saving 18.2 M$ does not reproduce from the printed row (about 1.2); 'lowest' in the Sect. 4.3 tables is per ore type (gold crushing lowest 427 vs overall 253). Mill sample ranges mix gold and iron ore. Fig. 3.5 is printed rotated; values verified to sum (mining 11 766 = 5 691 + 4 301 + 355 + 1 419).
